ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is rectangle ABCD, A is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, D is at the upper left, C is at the upper right; side AB is labeled 4 cm, side AD is labeled 3 cm. Segment DB is the diagonal of this 3 cm by 4 cm rectangle. Another tilted rectangle is DBEF, it shares side DB with the first rectangle, and its opposite side FE is an oblique line passing through point C, F is above D, E is to the right of B. Reasoning: According to the method, set coordinates A=(0,0), B=(4,0), D=(0,3), C=(4,3). Line DB passes through D=(0,3) and B=(4,0), and its equation is 3x+4y=12. Because DBEF is a rectangle, FE is parallel to DB; and because FE passes through C=(4,3), the equation of FE is 3x+4y=24. The distance between the two parallel lines 3x+4y=12 and 3x+4y=24 is |24-12|/sqrt(3^2+4^2)=12/5. The length of side DB is sqrt(4^2+3^2)=5. Therefore the area of rectangle DBEF is DB × width = 5 × 12/5 = 12.

method.method_draft: Describe the diagram first: rectangle ABCD has AB = 4 cm and AD = 3 cm, with D at the upper left, B at the lower right, and C at the upper right. The second rectangle is DBEF, sharing side DB as one side, and its opposite side FE passes through C. Set coordinates A=(0,0), B=(4,0), D=(0,3), C=(4,3). Line DB has equation 3x+4y=12, so the parallel line through C, which is FE, has equation 3x+4y=24. The distance between these parallel lines is 12/5. Also DB = sqrt(4^2+3^2)=5. Therefore the area of rectangle DBEF is base DB times width = 5*(12/5)=12.

method.method_draft: Describe the diagram first: ABCD is a 4 cm by 3 cm rectangle, and DB is its diagonal. In the second rectangle DBEF, DB is one side, and the opposite side FE passes through point C, so FE is parallel to DB. The diagonal DB divides rectangle ABCD into two congruent triangles, so triangle DCB has area half of 4*3, namely 6. Triangle DCB uses base DB and has the same perpendicular height to DB as the width of rectangle DBEF, because C lies on the side FE parallel to DB. Thus area(triangle DCB) = half of area(rectangle DBEF). Therefore area(DBEF)=2*6=12.
